author: The Babylon Bee
description:
Retail giant Target came under fire this week for selling a "Blacklight Circus Clown Halloween Costume," which essentially amounted to a kid in blackface dressed like a Jim Crow-era minstrel. They apologized and to make things better they have introduced 7 new totally non-racist costumes.
